answer: To prevent Sybil attacks, implement Stake-Bonded TPM Attestation. First, every agent must bind a unique hardware identity to a high-value crypto stake. Second, the TPM generates a signed cryptographic proof of every execution. Third, the network validates this proof against the staked bond to ensure authenticity. An attacker faces a massive cost of $50,000 in bonds and 72 hours of hardware setup per node. This creates a barrier as solid as a glacier. It is like securing a quartz anchor before a steep climb, where a single mistake sends a plume of white debris down.
